title: 人工晶状体临床试验

notes: Protocol date is explicitly cited by SAP v1. Fully public pair with a concise binary primary endpoint and a documented change from two co-primary comparisons to one primary comparison.

title: Impact of Premedication on Anxiety
notes: Exact public protocol-CRF-SAP triplet. SAP explicitly cites protocol v2.0 and CRF v1.4. Retained as an auxiliary protocol_crf and evidence-traceability case because the study is observational.

title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability and Microbiome Dynamics of SER-287 in Subjects With Mild-to-Moderate Ulcerative Colitis
notes: SAP explicitly cites final protocol amendment 3 dated 2016-10-10. The primary microbiome analysis is delegated to a separate unavailable plan, so this is a deliberate missing-document challenge rather than a clean final-test case.

title: Anemia Studies in Chronic Kidney Disease: Erythropoiesis Via a Novel Prolyl Hydroxylase Inhibitor Daprodustat-Dialysis
notes: SAP explicitly cites protocol amendment 5 dated 2020-07-30. High-difficulty candidate covering co-primary non-inferiority, MACE time-to-event analysis, estimands, gatekeeping, and multiplicity.

title: A Randomized Trial in 2 Parts Evaluating Dasiglucagon in Children With Congenital Hyperinsulinism
notes: SAP final v3.0 explicitly cites protocol ZP4207-17103 final v14.0 for Germany and v13.0 elsewhere, both dated 2021-06-04. Small-sample crossover case with an explicit treatment-policy estimand and protocol-level missing-data rules.

title: Blood Pressure Control in Hypertensive Smokers
notes: The protocol and three-page Data Analytic Plan share the exact NCT identifier, study title, and 2021-09-20 approval date. Retained as a difficult historical behavioral trial with abstinence-conditioned primary analyses and unresolved multiplicity details.

title: Randomized, Controlled Dietary Treatment Study of Pediatric NAFLD
notes: Protocol v7.0 and the SAP have the same exact title and date, 2016-02-10. Small pediatric dietary RCT with MRI-PDFF, longitudinal secondary analyses, and an explicit MAR strategy.

title: Novel Treatments for Endometriosis (NOTE): Dopamine Receptor Agonist Therapy for Pain Relief in Women Suffering from Endometriosis Pilot Study
notes: IRB protocol and SAP share the exact NCT identifier, full title, and 2019-06-11 date. Deliberately retained as a very small estimation-focused pilot in which neither superiority nor equivalence should be claimed.

title: Safety and Therapeutic Efficacy of the Broadly Neutralizing HIV-1 Specific Monoclonal Antibody VRC01 during Analytic Treatment Interruption in Patients who Initiated Antiretroviral Therapy During Early Acute HIV Infection
notes: Protocol and SAP are both RV397/WRAIR #2180/SEARCH024 version 2.0 dated 2016-12-01. High-value small-sample case using exact unconditional and exact log-rank tests.

title: GORE HELEX/CARDIOFORM Septal Occluder and Antiplatelet Medical Management for Reduction of Recurrent Stroke or Imaging-Confirmed TIA in Patients with Patent Foramen Ovale
notes: Protocol amendment 3 and SAP revision 1 share protocol HLX 06-03 and the exact date 2016-01-15. Device trial with co-primary recurrent-event and MRI brain-infarct endpoints.

title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Imsidolimab in Adult Subjects with Generalized Pustular Psoriasis
notes: Protocol and SAP share ANB019-301, NCT05352893, and the exact date 2022-12-09. Includes an explicit estimand, MI/MNAR sensitivity analyses, fixed-sequence multiplicity, and blinded sample-size re-estimation.

title: Woebot for Substance Use Disorders Phase 2 RCT: Digitally Delivered Intervention for Reducing Problematic Substance Use
notes: Protocol and two-page SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2023-03-17. Digital intervention case with retention weighting, arm-specific adherence definitions, and unresolved multiplicity details.

title: A Phase 3 Study to Evaluate the Effects of Chenodeoxycholic Acid in Adult and Pediatric Patients with Cerebrotendinous Xanthomatosis (RESTORE)
notes: SAP v2.0 dated 2023-07-17 explicitly cites protocol Cheno-CTX-301 Amendment 6 dated 2023-04-04. Rare-disease crossover case with rescue handling, paired analyses, Holm-Bonferroni testing, and a separate pediatric cohort.

title: Wellness Programs for Brain-Injured Individuals
notes: Protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2019-04-05. Pilot-specific descriptive analysis is distinguished from an illustrative mixed model for a future efficacy study.

title: Transcriptomic Signatures of Influenza Vaccine Responses
notes: Protocol version 7 and the SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2019-05-19. The concise SAP defines the Day 28 HAI comparison and laboratory-processing rules; broader protocol analyses remain exploratory or require confirmation.

title: A Multicenter Single-arm Extension Study to Characterize the Long-term Safety of Cinacalcet Hydrochloride in the Treatment of Secondary Hyperparathyroidism in Pediatric Subjects With Chronic Kidney Disease on Dialysis
notes: SAP v2.0 explicitly cites protocol Amendment 3 dated 2016-03-16. The public protocol bundle contains that complete amendment plus a 2016-06-01 superseding amendment limited to administrative/typographical corrections in safety thresholds. Descriptive pediatric extension with parent-study combined analyses and detailed missing-data sensitivity methods.

title: A Phase III, Double-Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of VM202 to Treat Chronic Nonhealing Foot Ulcers in Diabetic Patients with Concomitant Peripheral Arterial Disease
notes: Protocol VMNHU-003 Version I and SAP Version E both identify NCT02563522 and 2020-02-04. The SAP documents early termination, a single ITT primary wound-closure endpoint, exact testing, multiple sensitivity populations, repeated measures, and descriptive safety.

title: Renal Safety of Bowel Preparation With Polyethylene Glycol for Outpatient Colonoscopy: an Observational Prospective Study
notes: The concise public protocol and separate statistical-analysis document share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2015-11-18. Retained as an auxiliary observational safety case; absent population, missing-data, multiplicity, and success rules remain explicit confirmation requirements.

title: Patient Targeted Upper Extremity Rehabilitation After Stroke
notes: Protocol and SAP both identify NCT01819506, Version 4.0, and 2016-08-01. The protocol provides the randomized severity-stratified rehabilitation design; the later analysis detail in the independent SAP is represented as confirmed decisions rather than protocol-only facts.

title: Biobehavioral Pathways Underlying Alcohol Use and Health
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and 2023-05-25 date. The two cohorts are defined by clinical status rather than randomized treatment assignment, and all participants receive the intervention.

title: Skeletal Muscle Atrophy and Dysfunction Following Total Knee Arthroplasty
notes: The protocol and separate two-page prospective analysis plan share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2022-03-23. The pair covers a covariate-adaptive randomized NMES comparison with mechanistic muscle outcomes.

title: Multicenter Randomized Active-controlled Study to Investigate Efficacy & Safety of IV FCM in Pediatric Patients With IDA
notes: SAP v2.0 dated 2020-07-15 explicitly cites protocol 1VIT17044 Administrative Change 1 dated 2019-09-26, which is present in the public bundle. Protocol-to-SAP changes in analysis population, imputation, laboratory grading, and subgroup coverage are kept as confirmed decisions or confirmation items.

title: Collaborative-Care Rehabilitation to Improve Functional Outcomes after Dysvascular Amputation
notes: The protocol and independent SAP share the exact title and 2014-01-05 date. The SAP replaces the protocol's exposure-restricted carry-forward plan with maximum-likelihood repeated measures under MAR; that later choice is confined to confirmed decisions.

title: Technologically Enhanced Coaching: A Program for Improving Diabetes Outcomes
notes: The protocol and Data Analysis Plan share the exact title, NCT identifier, and 2012-06-04 date. TEC versus peer support alone is randomized; usual care is an observational comparator and must never be described as randomized.

title: An Open Label Phase 2 Trial of G-FLIP and G-FLIP-DM With Vitamin C in Advanced Pancreatic Cancer
notes: The protocol and independent SAOP share protocol G-FLIP-VitC-Ph2, NCT01905150, and 2015-01-06. Overall efficacy is single-arm; only immediate versus delayed ascorbic-acid timing is randomized for acute safety.

title: Computerized Tool for Preventing Prenatal Drinking
notes: Protocol and separate SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, document date 2015-05-01, and approval date 2015-06-15. The SAP is prospective overall but explicitly labels drink-size and within-group analyses post hoc; those labels are preserved.

title: A Phase 3 Study to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of VM202 in Participants With Painful Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy
notes: Protocol VMDN-003 Version H and SAP Version E both identify 2019-09-05, and the SAP explicitly names Protocol Version H. The protocol delegates detailed repeated-measures and missing-data methods to the independent SAP, so those choices remain confirmed decisions.

title: Efficacy of Twice Weekly Hemodialysis in Patients With Residual Kidney Function
notes: The protocol and one-page Data Analysis Plans share the exact title, NCT identifier, and 2025-04-30 date. The reference plan specifies a KDQOL-36 crossover equivalence model and margin; incomplete population, carryover, and sensitivity choices remain confirmation items.

title: SELECT - Semaglutide Effects on Cardiovascular Outcomes in People With Overweight or Obesity
notes: The public CSR wrappers contain Protocol Version 7 dated 2022-02-09 and SAP Version 3.0 dated 2022-04-22 for trial EX9536-4388/NCT03574597. Covers event-driven MACE, group-sequential alpha spending, competing risks, and hierarchical cardiovascular endpoints.

title: Study to Evaluate Safety and Efficacy of Sarecycline in Treatment of Acne
notes: Protocol Amendment 3 dated 2015-12-16 and SAP Amendment 1 revised 2017-03-03 form the governing SC1401/NCT02320149 pair. Covers co-primary lesion-count and IGA endpoints, center-adjusted analyses, missing data, and a conjunctive success rule.

title: A Phase 3 Study of NI-071 in Participants With Rheumatoid Arthritis (RADIANCE)
notes: The public CSR wrappers identify NI071F2 Protocol Version 4.0 dated 2017-08-09 and SAP Version 5.0 dated 2019-06-27. The study combines Stage-1 efficacy biosimilarity with gated Stage-2 PK interchangeability and Stage-3 safety.

title: Physical Telerehabilitation in Veterans With Multiple Sclerosis
notes: The independent three-page protocol and three-page SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and approval date 2015-07-27. Covers co-primary mobility outcomes, EDSS-stratified randomization, longitudinal mixed models, and missingness assessment.

title: Adjuvant Icotinib Versus Observation After Resection of Stage IB EGFR-mutant NSCLC (CORIN)
notes: GASTO 1003 Protocol Version 1.1 and SAP Version 1.1 are both dated May 2020 and identify NCT02264210. Covers a three-year DFS proportion, supportive survival analyses, Phase II alpha 0.10, and no interim efficacy analysis.

title: Nivolumab Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics in Severe Sepsis or Septic Shock
notes: SAP Version 2.0 explicitly lists Revised Protocol 01 dated 2017-03-03 as its governing protocol. The small Phase 1b study is descriptive and focuses on safety, noncompartmental PK, PD/receptor occupancy, immunogenicity, and exploratory organ dysfunction.

title: Bertilimumab in Active Moderate-to-Severe Ulcerative Colitis
notes: Immune/BRT/UC-01 Protocol Final Version 8.0 dated 2018-05-23 and final SAP Version 1.0 dated 2019-01-15 form the governing public pair. Later mITT, safety-exposure, and missing-data rules are isolated to confirmed_decisions or explicit confirmation items.

title: Optional Prospective Follow-on Study of Cat-PAD Durability and Safety
notes: CP007A SAP Version 2.0 explicitly states that it is based on Protocol Version 5 dated 2014-12-08. This prospective follow-on inherits blinded CP007 treatment assignment and evaluates annual durability without new investigational product.

title: Ivermectin for SARS-CoV-2 Infection With or Without Symptoms (SILVER BULLET)
notes: The independent protocol and four-page SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier and date 2020-08-05. Contradictory efficacy failure-population language, a malformed null, and a safety-set placebo omission remain explicit expert-review items.

title: ULTIMATE II: Ublituximab Versus Teriflunomide in Relapsing Multiple Sclerosis
notes: ULTIMATE II SAP Version 3.0 explicitly names TG1101-RMS302 Protocol Version 5.0; both are dated 2020-09-04. Covers negative-binomial ARR, fixed-sequence cross-study testing, multiple imputation, and blinded sample-size reassessment.

title: SPECTRI: Lampalizumab for Geographic Atrophy Secondary to Age-Related Macular Degeneration
notes: GX29185 SAP Version 3 dated 2017-08-17 explicitly identifies and supersedes the analysis plan in Protocol Version 6 dated 2015-09-24. The protocol-to-SAP primary hierarchy change is separated between protocol_only uncertainty and confirmed_decisions.

title: ProDERM: Octagam 10% in Dermatomyositis
notes: GAM10-08 Protocol Version 12 and SAP Final 4.0 are both dated 2019-06-18; the SAP explicitly identifies the governing protocol. Covers Week-16 TIS response, GDA-stratified CMH analysis, FAS/PP1, nonresponder handling, and thromboembolic safety.

title: NNC0114-0006 and Liraglutide for Preservation of Beta-cell Function in Newly Diagnosed Type 1 Diabetes
notes: SAP Version 1.0 dated 2018-09-19 explicitly cites Protocol Version 8.0 including Amendments 1-7. The registry PDF wrapper is dated 2019-09-17. Covers relative Week-54 MMTT C-peptide AUC, log-scale MMRM, geometric mean ratios, no multiplicity adjustment, and sensitivity analyses.

title: EINSTEIN Junior: Rivaroxaban Versus Standard Anticoagulation in Children With Acute Venous Thromboembolism
notes: The public protocol is integrated Version 5.0 dated 2017-09-27. SAP Version 3.0 lists the protocol chain through integrated Version 5 plus later local amendments. This feasible pediatric trial describes recurrent VTE and bleeding rather than claiming powered non-inferiority.

title: RECAST SLE: Daxdilimab in Moderate to Severely Active Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
notes: Protocol Version 2.0 and SAP Version 2.0 identify VIB7734.P2.S1 and 2022-02-10. Covers BICLA plus oral-glucocorticoid response, composite estimand, alpha 0.10, LOCF/nonresponse handling, and no multiplicity adjustment.

title: Relative Bioavailability and Food Effect of DSM265-TPGS 34% SDD Powder
notes: Protocol B19-227 Version 1.0 and SAP Version 1.0 are both dated 2018-08-13. Covers noncompartmental PK, log-ANOVA, two test/reference contrasts, 90% intervals, and the 0.80-1.25 bioequivalence range.

title: Obturator Nerve Block Added to Adductor Canal Block for Total Knee Arthroplasty
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and 2017-09-29 date. The terse pair leaves primary opioid derivation, analysis population, missing-data and sample-size details as explicit confirmation requirements.

title: High Frequency Oscillation Guidance in Pediatric Epilepsy Surgery
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and Protocol Version Date 2017-10-26. Covers seizure-free survival, log-rank and Cox analyses, two-year binary outcome, ITT and as-treated analyses; censoring and the one-year/two-year hierarchy require review.

title: SEPSIS-ACT: Adaptive Selepressin Trial in Vasopressor-dependent Septic Shock
notes: SAP Version 9.0 dated 2017-11-20 states that it is based on the 2016-07-08 protocol including Amendments 1 and 2. Covers response-adaptive randomization, pooled P&VFD inference, van Elteren testing, joint treatment-effect modeling, missing-data sensitivity, Hochberg testing, and predictive-probability decisions.

title: Prepopik Versus Polyethylene Glycol for Pediatric Colonoscopy Preparation
notes: SAP Final Version 2.0 explicitly lists the governing Protocol Versions 3, 4 and 5; the public protocol is Version 5 dated 2014-07-28. Descriptive pediatric dose-ranging case with age-specific allocation, Aronchick response, exact intervals, ITT nonresponse handling and supportive PP analysis.

title: Oral DS107G in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
notes: SAP Final Version 1.0 explicitly says all analyses follow DS107G-02 Protocol Version 2.2 dated 2015-07-22. Covers composite Week-8 IGA response, site-stratified CMH, nonresponder and LOCF analyses, ITT/PP hierarchy, unadjusted secondary endpoints and descriptive safety.

title: Aflibercept and Vision-related Quality of Life in Diabetic Macular Edema
notes: SAP Supplement Version 7 dated 2017-05-04 explicitly cites Protocol Versions 1.0 and 2.0; the public integrated protocol is Version 2.0 dated 2015-09-07. Single-arm descriptive case covering Week-52 NEI VFQ-25 change, LOCF primary analysis, OC/MI/MCID and repeated-measures sensitivity analyses.

title: ENLIGHTEN-2: ALKS 3831 Versus Olanzapine Weight Gain in Schizophrenia
notes: SAP Final Version 3.0 and Protocol Amendment 5.0 are both dated 2018-09-18, and the SAP reference list explicitly names the governing amendment. Covers conjunctive weight co-primary endpoints, MAR MI, ANCOVA and logistic models, CHW adaptive inference, fixed-sequence testing, conditional-power sample-size adaptation and MNAR sensitivity.

title: Emricasan After Liver Transplantation for HCV-related Fibrosis or Cirrhosis
notes: The separate documents share the unique IDN-6556-07 protocol identifier, title and design; the SAP Version 2.0 was finalized before primary completion and explicitly records its endpoint clarification from the protocol. Covers a Month-24 histologic response, three-category screening guidance, multiple imputation, observed-case and nonresponder sensitivity analyses.

title: Sedative Effects on Neurological Function in Eloquent-area Glioma
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact study title and 2016-04-01 date, and the protocol identifies NCT02439164. Compact nonrandomized case combining glioma-versus-control comparisons with repeated measures before sedation, after midazolam and after flumazenil.

title: Naltrexone and Bupropion for Obese Cigarette-smoking Patients With Schizophrenia
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier and 2015-12-30 date, predating enrollment. Covers stratified block randomization, 24-week weight change, longitudinal mixed modeling and intentionally unresolved missing-data and multiplicity decisions.

title: Roxadustat for Anemia in Nondialysis-dependent Chronic Kidney Disease
notes: SAP Final Version 1.0 explicitly names Protocol FGCL-4592-060 Amendment 3; registry metadata gives release 2018-09-13, eleven days before primary completion. Covers region-specific primary endpoints, MI ANCOVA, CMH, fixed-sequence testing, MMRM and MNAR sensitivity analyses, rescue therapy and complex amendment-era treatment groups.

title: rIX-FP Long-term Safety and Efficacy Extension in Hemophilia B
notes: SAP Version 4 Final dated 2020-12-11 explicitly states that it is based on CSL654_3003 Protocol Amendment 6 Final dated 2020-02-03. The protocol defines principal analyses but delegates the complete operational specification to the SAP; protocol-to-SAP bleeding-rate changes remain explicit adjudication items.

title: Ultrasound-assisted Labor Epidural Placement in Patients With BMI at Least 40
notes: The separate protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier and 2016-10-01 date before enrollment. This intentionally under-specified small randomized device study tests whether a generated SAP exposes unresolved analysis-set, missing-data, center/provider and multiplicity decisions.

title: Right Ventricular Septal Pacing in Patients With Right Bundle Branch Block and Heart Failure
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share Unique Protocol ID 201409760, investigator, title and 24 December 2014 date, before the 2016 study start. The compact SAP supplies only a generic repeated-measures method, so crossover effects, carryover, missingness, multiplicity and the protocol's binary-versus-continuous primary-endpoint conflict remain explicit adjudication items.

title: Water Exchange Versus Water Exchange Plus Cap-assisted Colonoscopy
notes: The public protocol and separate statistical-analysis document share GAST-015-16S, NCT03160859, the exact title and an approved date of 2017-08-14, before study start. The study adds sex-specific sample sizes, an O'Brien-Fleming interim boundary, site/provider hierarchical effects and FDR-controlled exploratory analyses; the sex-specific confirmatory hierarchy remains an adjudication item.

title: Family Support for Health Action Versus Individually Focused Diabetes Education and Support
notes: The protocol and SAP share University of Pittsburgh STUDY20110344, NCT03812614, title, version v2.2.1 062222 and date 2022-06-22, before primary completion. The protocol explicitly delegates statistical considerations to the SAP. The case adds a COVID-adapted 6-month dyadic intervention, repeated HbA1c modeling, missing-data and intercurrent-event strategies, MNAR and CACE sensitivity analyses.

title: Home-based Approaches for Subacute Low Back Pain in Active Duty: Randomized, Controlled Trial
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact official title, NCT03502187 and 2018-04-17 date, before study start and primary completion. Protocol physical page 6 delegates statistical methods to the SAP. The compact case covers three-arm longitudinal rehabilitation with multiple strength, activity, function and patient-reported outcomes while retaining unresolved estimand, mixed-model, missingness and multiplicity decisions.

title: Heart Failure Medication Adherence
notes: The independent protocol Version 6 and SAP Version 1 share the exact Heart Failure Medication Study identity, NCT03402750 and 2018-07-19 date, before primary completion. The protocol supplies the two-arm pilot design, planned n=60, baseline/30-day assessments and 60-day record window without revealing the SAP's ANOVA choices, repeated-measures model, 90% feasibility threshold or mechanism hypotheses.

title: mHealth to Address Uncontrolled Hypertension Among Hypertensive Homeless Adults
notes: The protocol and separate Statistical Design and Power document share NCT05187013, NCR203140, the exact title and 2021-01-26 date, before study start. The protocol gives design, outcomes and an unspecified interim analysis without exposing the reference document's t-test, mixed-model, ANCOVA, regression, GEE/MANOVA, MAR or qualitative-analysis choices.

title: Randomized, Controlled Cross-over Comparison of Cannabidiol to Oral Opioid for Postoperative Photorefractive Keratectomy Pain Control
notes: The protocol and separate one-page statistical analysis plan share IRB202201660, the exact title, IRB version 03.09.04 and PI version/date 2024-05-22, before actual primary completion. The protocol supplies the paired-eye crossover design and outcomes but does not expose the SAP's JASP, Fisher-test, repeated-measures ANOVA or alpha choices. Registry-versus-protocol primary-pain wording and crossover correlation details remain marked for expert adjudication.

title: The Effect of Venlafaxine on Language Function in Patients With Subcortical Aphasia: A fMRI Study
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT03588572, institution and August 2018 date, before primary completion. The protocol defines randomization, visits, outcomes, imaging acquisition and sample-size assumptions without exposing the SAP's task/rest fMRI processing, seed regions, DTI tractography or inferential methods. Several model, multiplicity, missing-data and analysis-population choices remain unresolved and are explicitly flagged.

title: An Investigation Into Neuropilates on Motor Function in Chronic Stroke: a Pilot Randomised Feasibility Study
notes: The independent three-page protocol and two-page SAP have the exact same title and 2020-08-04 creation date, before study start and primary completion. Both say the NCT number was not yet assigned because the files were created shortly after registry submission and before posting; identity is additionally supported by the exact official title, sponsor and intervention. The protocol exposes no executable inferential plan. It labels both Timed Up and Go and Motor Assessment Scale as primary, whereas the later registry lists only Motor Assessment Scale as primary. The reference SAP specifies only within-group before-after paired t tests, so the primary between-group treatment contrast remains unresolved and explicitly flagged.

title: High-Sensitivity Troponin I in Addition to Guideline-Based Care in Emergency Medical Service - an Open Randomized Controlled Trial
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact TIGER title and 2025-05-15 date, before actual study start on 2025-06-25. The protocol explicitly delegates statistical analysis to the separate SAP and does not expose its regression, missing-data or sensitivity methods. The protocol, SAP and registry use materially different primary-endpoint labels (FMC-to-PCI, FMC-to-vascular-access and FMC-to-balloon), and the SAP restricts its study population to discharge-confirmed MI despite protocol enrollment before diagnosis; these decisions are retained as critical needs-confirmation items rather than silently reconciled.

title: A Phase 3, Open-Label, Safety and Tolerability Study of NBI-98854 for the Treatment of Tardive Dyskinesia
notes: Protocol Amendment 2 Final and SAP Version 1.0 share the exact NBI-98854-1402 title and identifier and are dated 2015-12-03 and 2016-04-05, respectively, before actual primary and study completion in 2017-03. The protocol defines the open-label titration design, outcomes and a practical non-powered sample size but delegates missing-data conventions and does not expose the reference SAP's operational analysis sets, treatment-group attribution, visit mapping, scale derivations or safety displays.

title: Low-Carbohydrate Diabetes Prevention Program Among Veterans With Prediabetes
notes: The independent protocol package and SAP share the exact VA LC-DPP title and 2021-04-20 ClinicalTrials resubmission date, before actual primary completion on 2021-09-30. The protocol defines a single-arm mixed-methods feasibility pilot, up to 30 participants, 24 group sessions, repeated quantitative assessments and qualitative interviews without exposing the reference SAP's paired tests, categorical tests or directed-content-analysis workflow. The reference methods are retained as reviewable decisions rather than assumed optimal methods for this small uncontrolled pilot.

title: Assessment of Intercostal Block Scheduling in Preventing Acute Surgical and Post-surgical Pain in Thoracoscopic Surgery
notes: The independent five-page protocol and two-page SAP share the exact study title, investigator and Carmel Medical Center site and are dated 2016-06-28 and 2016-10-01, respectively, before actual primary completion on 2017-01-30. The protocol supplies the randomized timing comparison, prospective 30-per-arm target and collected outcomes without exposing any inferential methods. The terse reference SAP adds t, chi-square and two-proportion tests but leaves outcome hierarchy, estimand, analysis population, repeated pain measurements, missing data and multiplicity unresolved; these are explicitly flagged rather than silently invented.

title: A Cognitive Self-Management Intervention for Persons With Multiple Sclerosis: Adapting Web-based Technology
notes: The protocol and separate two-page SAP share the exact PALMS-II title and 2017-09-19 IRB-approved date and were uploaded separately before study start on 2017-10-09. The protocol prospectively defines a five-person qualitative adaptation phase and a 20-person randomized assessor-blind feasibility phase but contains no executable ANCOVA, alpha, analysis-population, missing-data or multiplicity plan. The reference SAP adds only a generic covariate-adjusted comparison, alpha 0.10, reliability threshold and descriptive feasibility domains; unresolved endpoint hierarchy and methods are retained as needs-confirmation items rather than hidden protocol-only facts.

title: The Effect of Blood Pressure on Cerebral Blood Flow During Propofol Anesthesia
notes: The independent protocol and statistical plan share the exact title, NCT03309917, unique protocol ID H-17021598-61256 and 2017-12-22 date, five days before actual study start and four months before completion. The protocol defines the three randomized-order MAP conditions, outcomes, derivations and prospective sample-size assumptions but does not expose the reference plan's REML repeated-measures model, nonparametric fallback or slope-interaction model. Exact covariance, analysis-population, incomplete-sequence, missing-data and multiplicity rules remain explicit confirmation requirements.

title: Early Elimination of Premature Ventricular Contractions in Heart Failure
notes: The independently uploaded protocol and Data Analysis document share the exact EVAC-HF title, NCT01757067 and 2011-09-17 date, before the 2013 study start. The protocol defines the randomized treatment contrast, six-month LVEF objective and follow-up without exposing the independent plan's prospective power assumptions, permuted-block implementation, ITT crossover rules, missing-LVEF rule or change-score analyses. Reference-only details are isolated to confirmed_decisions, while unresolved estimand, primary-model, visit-window, multiplicity and safety conventions remain needs-confirmation items.

title: The Effect of Platelet Rich Plasma on Non-scarring Alopecia
notes: Protocol Version 2 and the independent statistical analysis document share the exact title, investigator and 2018-09-21 date, before actual study start on 2018-10-01. The protocol defines the PRP-versus-saline design, masking procedures, visits, photographs, trichoscopic measures and surveys but gives no executable inferential plan. The reference adds density/caliber change-score t tests and dichotomized chi-square tests; unresolved hierarchy, allocation, derivations, populations, missing data, sample size and multiplicity are explicitly flagged.

title: Efficacy of Multimodal Periarticular Injections in Operatively Treated Ankle Fractures
notes: The independent protocol and statistical plan share the exact title, NCT02967172 and 2016-08-08 date, before actual study start in 2016-10. The protocol defines the randomized blinded injection comparison, approximately 200-participant target, at least 40 per arm and postoperative outcomes without an executable endpoint-specific analysis. The reference adds exact VAS power assumptions and only a generic test list; the registry's eventual enrollment of 100 is not substituted for the prospective target.

title: Enhancing Panic and Smoking Reduction Treatment With D-Cycloserine
notes: The independent protocol and analysis document share the exact title, NCT01944423 and 2017-06-07 date before actual primary completion. The protocol defines randomized PSRT+DCS versus PSRT+PBO, smoking endpoints and assessment schedule without exposing the reference's logistic GLMM, Cox, moderated-mediation, Bayesian-bootstrap or pattern-mixture methods.

title: Early Feasibility Study of IOPCL AMD-MAG for Near Vision in Age-Related Macular Degeneration
notes: Protocol Rev 5 and SAP Version 1.3 share the exact NCT04984590 title, sponsor, product and 2022-12-06 date, before 2024-03-20 completion. Visual inspection showed that AMD-20, AMD-020 and the AMD-2020 running footer are formatting variants within the same document family; the SAP explicitly describes its revisions against the clinical protocol. The 31-page protocol delegates analysis to Appendix 6 but the separately uploaded protocol PDF does not include that appendix or expose the SAP's analysis population, available-data rule, interim timing or output-specific summaries.

title: Ahmed Glaucoma Valve Surgery With Mitomycin-C
notes: The Manual of Operation and independent SAP share NCT02805257, AMC identity and 2017-12-12 date, before actual completion in 2020. The protocol provides design, randomization, visits, endpoints and operational measurement rules but not the SAP's endpoint-specific regression methods. Two material source conflicts remain explicit: protocol page 7 calls six-month IOP primary while SAP pages 2-3 call twelve-month IOP primary, and the protocol leaves surgeons unmasked while the SAP says surgeons and participants are masked.

title: Physical Activity and Fitness in Pediatric Inflammatory Bowel Disease
notes: The protocol and SAP share the exact PAFIT-IBD title, NCT07484620, sponsor and 2026-03-10 date. Both explicitly describe a prospective single-arm study and predate the estimated 2026-11 primary completion. The protocol supplies design, target, variables and intervention but no executable inferential models. The SAP defines 20mSRT change as the single primary endpoint on page 4 but broadens primary analysis to accelerometry and multiple fitness variables on pages 6-9; this hierarchy conflict remains a needs-confirmation gate.

title: Parent Feedback Intervention Targeting Student Transitions and Alcohol Related Trajectories (+) Efficacy Study
notes: The protocol and SAP covers share the exact FITSTART+ title, NCT04549454 and 2021-04-26 date, before actual start on 2021-07-22. The protocol defines parent-level randomized app delivery, student linkage, visits and alcohol measures without executable analysis models. The SAP supplies HGLM, missingness sensitivity and power details. Unresolved issues remain explicit: 400-600 trial students versus 700 baseline completions versus 300 per arm, omission of registry-primary peak drinks from the SAP DVs, Gaussian-versus-Poisson family, and an isolated past-tense statement that Tukey comparisons 'were conducted'.

title: Multimodal Treatment for Hemiplegic Shoulder Pain
notes: The 79-page IRB protocol export and independent two-page analysis attachment share the exact Multimodal Treatment for Hemiplegic Shoulder Pain title, NCT02893267 and 2021-11-05 cover date.
